title: 秋思（洛阳城里见秋风）
author: 张籍
intro: Anyone who has rewritten a message home will recognise this one: a man far from home writes a letter, then, as the messenger is about to leave, opens it again to add one more thing.
analysis: 诗人住在洛阳，看到秋风起了，想念家乡，想写一封家信，心里的话却有千重万重。信写好了，他还是担心匆匆忙忙没写完；送信的人临出发前，他又把信封拆开再看一遍。全诗没有直接写“想家”，只写了一个小小的动作——“又开封”，却把那种说不完、放不下的思念写活了。这种用平常细节表达深情的写法，很容易引起共鸣。第一句的“秋风”也有来历：晋朝的张翰在洛阳看到秋风起，想起家乡的菜和鱼，就辞官回家了。张籍在这里暗用这个典故，表达思乡之情。
analysisEn: The poet is living in Luoyang. When the autumn wind starts to blow he thinks of home and decides to write a letter, but there are a thousand layers of things he wants to say. The letter is finished, yet he worries that in his hurry he has left something out — so, just as the traveller who will carry it is setting off, he opens the envelope one more time. The poem never says “I miss home.” It shows one small, familiar action, and that is enough: we feel how much he has to say and how hard it is to let the letter go. Small everyday details like this are what make the poem so easy to relate to. The autumn wind in the first line also carries an old story. In the Jin dynasty a man named Zhang Han, serving as an official in Luoyang, saw the autumn wind rise, remembered the vegetables and fish of his home region, and resigned on the spot to go back. Zhang Ji quietly borrows that story to show how strong his own homesickness is.
background: Zhang Ji (c. 766–c. 830) came from the south and held modest posts in the capital; he was a friend of Han Yu and Bai Juyi. He is known for plain, sincere poems about ordinary people and everyday feelings.
pronunciation: 多音字：意万重 chóng（层，不读 zhòng）；行人 xíng；临发 fā；见秋风 jiàn。
version: 采用通行版本（统编教材选本）。

lines.py: luò yáng chéng lǐ jiàn qiū fēng
lines.lit: In the city of Luoyang I see the autumn wind;
lines.en: In Luoyang the autumn wind has come;

lines.py: yù zuò jiā shū yì wàn chóng
lines.lit: I want to write a letter home — my thoughts are ten thousand layers deep.
lines.en: I sit to write home, with a thousand things to say.

lines.py: fù kǒng cōng cōng shuō bù jìn
lines.lit: Again I fear that in my haste I have not said it all;
lines.en: Then I worry that in my rush I’ve left something out,

lines.py: xíng rén lín fā yòu kāi fēng
lines.lit: as the traveller is about to set off, I open the seal again.
lines.en: and as the courier turns to go, I open the letter again.

words.en: Luoyang, a great city of the Tang dynasty
to want to; to be about to
words.note: 现代汉语说“想要”；还有“欲望”。
“重”读 chóng，是“层”的意思，现代汉语有“重重”“万水千山”。
现代汉语常用，“匆匆忙忙”。

words.en: the traveller (here: the one carrying the letter)
words.note: 今天“行人”指走路的人，古义指出远门的人。
“临”是“快要、将要”，现代汉语有“临走”“临行”。

words.en: to open the seal (of a letter)
words.note: 现代汉语也说“开封”，如“食品开封后冷藏”。

imagery.name: 秋风
imagery.zh: 秋风引起思乡之情，也暗用张翰见秋风而辞官回乡的故事。
imagery.en: The autumn wind stirs his homesickness — and recalls Zhang Han, who quit his post when the autumn wind blew.

imagery.name: 家书
imagery.zh: 一封写了又拆的家信，装着说不完的牵挂。
imagery.en: A letter sealed and then opened again holds more love than words can finish.
